thread:
lia: FYI we've seen recurring truncated streaming responses (206) on /v1/stream/chat, notable spike at ~07:15 UTC — ~1.2k affected. Pattern looks like runtime closing mid-emit.

sam: Can you paste a couple sample log lines and regions?

lia: samples: 
```
2026-07-03T07:14:58Z req=c3a1 region=us-west status=206 emit_bytes=96 ERR=runtime:emit-interrupted; close=EOF
2026-07-03T07:15:12Z req=c3a2 region=us-east status=206 emit_bytes=32 ERR=proxy:drain-triggered
```

reena: Sounds similar to previous incidents where pod drains + client reconnect storms amplified partials. Propose a short action list and owners so we can close follow-ups.

ops-bot: INCIDENT_CREATED: #inc-2026-07-streaming-truncations (sev3)  responders: @lia @reena @sam

reena: Action items (I'll add to tracker):
1) Instrument per-stream state transitions (OPEN, FIRST_CHUNK, LAST_CHUNK, DRAIN_NOTICE, CLOSE_REASON)  owner:@reena  due: 2026-07-10
2) Add `partial_reason`/`partial_emit_reason` tag in logs/traces to distinguish drain/oom/socket  owner:@noah  due: 2026-07-08
3) Proxy: implement graceful reconnect/backoff + Retry-After header for forced disconnects  owner:@noah  due: 2026-07-09
4) Edge: throttle noisy reconnect loops (e.g., >30 short streams/min) with 429 + Retry-After and doc client backoff recipe  owner:@sam  due: 2026-07-11
5) Runtime: BestEffortFlush on drain with configurable grace (default 5s) and emit final control event `stream_truncated reason=drain`  owner:@reena  due: 2026-07-15
6) Observability: weekly partial_rate trend job + alert on >0.25% 5m spike  owner:@lia  due: 2026-07-12

noah: I'll start a small canary for the `partial_emit_reason` field and prototype Retry-After semantics at the proxy. Planning 10% canary once tests pass.

sam: I'll draft the edge throttle with exponential backoff + jitter example and add short client guidance to quickstart. ETA for canary: 48h.

reena: I'll add unit/integration tests simulating mid-stream pod drain and network jitter and schedule a 2h reproduction run in staging.

lia: Scheduling a short sync Fri 16:00 UTC to review PRs and canary metrics. Also adding a short playbook for on-call with grep commands to find candidate traces, e.g.:
```
rg "status=206" streaming-logs | rg "drain|emit-interrupted|stream_truncated|partial_emit_reason"
```

ops-bot: INCIDENT_UPDATE: ownership and deadlines recorded in postmortem tracker.

lia: Closing note  please keep action owners to due dates; if any canary exceeds partial_rate > 0.3% for 2h, rollback and escalate.

ops-bot: INCIDENT_RESOLVED: #inc-2026-07-streaming-truncations (informational)  mitigation plan in flight; follow-ups in tracker.
